summary: The Synthesis Eco range of 3 rimless toilets offers a modern solution for those looking for both style and efficiency in their bathrooms.
title: New Rimless Toilets Range - Crafted In Italy
bodyHtml:
A Marriage of Form and Flawless Functionality

The Synthesis Eco range of rimless toilets combines sleek aesthetics with innovative flushing technology, offering a modern solution for those seeking efficiency and style in their bathrooms.

Discover Synthesis Eco Toilets

Seamless Aesthetic across the Collection Decus Range

A Powerful, Yet Efficient Flush

Synthesis Eco has a powerful yet water efficient flush (4 Star WELS rating), with increased hygiene thanks to the rimless design, meaning there are no hard to reach places where bacteria can hide. You can learn more about rimless toilets in our in-depth guide here.

Additionally, all Studio Bagno toilets are enhanced with our CleanMax anti-bacterial glaze, effectively preventing the buildup of dirt and bacteria on your toilet's surface without additional cost.

Synthesis Eco Rimless Suite

The Art of Angles, Crafted in Softness

Synthesis Eco is the flagship toilet series of our Collection Decus, effortlessly complementing the soft square aesthetic and chamfer base found throughout the range.

Characterized by clean lines, subtle curves, and precise angles, Synthesis Eco exudes a luxurious contemporary style that seamlessly integrates into any modern bathroom space.

Synthesis Eco Rimless Wall Hung Pan

Luxury Packages - Elegance at Exceptional Value

Maximise sleek in your bathroom with Synthesis Eco Wall Faced and Wall Hung variations, available as a package with Oli In-Wall Cisterns.

Our Cisterns are the only cisterns on the Australian market with delayed refill technology, resulting in massive water and dollar savings. See our video about how it works below.
